name: week
title: This week at the stable
subtitle: Race clashes, Stable Returns, treatment records, races coming up and who owes

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: The same list as /attention. Rule breaches first.
sections.sql: select item, ref, detail from v_attention order by rank, item, ref

sections.title: Races coming up
sections.sql: select ref, horse, race_date, venue, race_no as race, status, acceptances, jockey, coalesce(clash, '') as clash from v_races where race_date >= local_today() and status <> 'scratched' order by race_date, venue

sections.title: Horses stood down
sections.note: Clear days under AR 86, 87, 88, 88A, 88AA, 249 and 255, counted from midnight on the day given.
sections.sql: select horse, product, rule, eligible_on from v_treatments where eligible_on > local_today() order by eligible_on

name: horses
title: Where every horse is
subtitle: In work, pre-training and spelling, with owners and the next race

sections.title: Horses
sections.sql: select code, name, sex, age, status, premises_name as premises, since, days_there, shares_percent as shares, next_race, last_update from v_horses where status <> 'left' order by status, name

sections.title: Stable Returns waiting
sections.note: AR 296(2): lodge the amendment immediately when a horse joins, leaves or moves.
sections.sql: select ref, horse, moved_local as moved, moved_to, return_standing, hours_to_lodge from v_movements where return_standing in ('pending', 'overdue') order by moved_at

name: treatments
title: Treatment register
subtitle: Every medication and treatment in the last 30 days, as AR 104 asks it to be kept

sections.title: Last 30 days
sections.sql: select ref, horse, given_local as given, kind, product, route, amount, given_by, authorised_by, reason, recorded_local as recorded, record_standing as record from v_treatments where given_at > local_now() - interval '30 days' order by given_at desc

name: money
title: Owner accounts
subtitle: What is owed, what is waiting to be billed

sections.title: Owing
sections.sql: select number, owner, month, dollars(total_cents) as total, dollars(owing_cents) as owing, due_on, days_overdue from v_invoices where owing_cents > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Charges not yet billed
sections.sql: select c.ref, h.name as horse, c.on_date, c.kind, c.description, dollars(c.amount_cents) as amount from charges c join horses h on h.id = c.horse_id where c.billed_month is null order by c.on_date
